'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Angelo Consoli LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''A tribute to Brad Reinhold'''. Username '''GravityShadow'''. Line 13 Coruscant (Special Edition). Additional cards on sheet (not in 60): Great Warrior; A Jedi's Strength; Domain Of Evil; Size Matters Not.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned|Mind What You Have Learned (V)]]
* '''Username:''' GravityShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
